title: MV/MZ A veteran of the game with a new profile

posts.author: winnythedude01
posts.body:
Hi Everyone
I have been around RPG Maker for a long time, starting with VX and VX Ace, then moving through MV and now MZ. Most of my time has been spent experimenting with plugins, systems, and ideas that were often way too ambitious to realistically finish. Like many people here, I have learned a lot through trial and error, restarting projects, and refining what I actually enjoy making.
These days, I really enjoy building smaller scale games, especially puzzle focused or dungeon style experiences. Nothing massive. Usually something my friends can finish in about 25 to 45 minutes. I find those kinds of projects much more satisfying and manageable, and they actually get finished. I'd like to make one with a little more playthrough though soon enough.
I had an old account on the forums that I barely used and eventually lost access to, so I am treating this as a fresh start and my main profile going forward. While I am definitely not an expert compared to many people here, I also would not consider myself new to the engine. I am looking forward to being more active, learning from others, and contributing where I can.
As for games I love, it is hard to pick just one favorite, but Red Dead Redemption 2, Terraria, and Banjo-Kazooie are all high on the list (Those just came to my head).
For what it is worth, my day job is actually as a professional magician, which still feels strange and fun to type out, but here we are.
Glad to be here, and I am looking forward to being part of the community with more intention!
Winny
